title: Haye Asghar Wawaila Haye Asghar Wawaila
body:
Haye Asghar Wawaila Haye Asghar Wawaila
tha Ye Bano Ka Nauha Haye Asghar Wawaila
01. Aaja Aaja Noor E Nazar.ro Ro Kehti Hai Madar
jeeena Nahi Ab Tere Bina Haye Asghar Wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
02. Tashnalabi Maidaan Jhula.tera Tabasum Halkasa
teri Shahadat Ka Nauha Haye Asghar Wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
03. Zulm Hua Tujh Par Aisa.teer E Sitam Masum Gala
mara Gaya Ran Me Pyasa Haye Asghar Wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
04. Jhula Jhulaau Mai Kisko Lori Sunau Mai Kisko
itna Bata De Aye Beta Haye Asghar Wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
05. Jhula Khaime Gowd Meri Aur Ye Dunya Bhi Sari
veera Hai Sab Tere Bina Haye Asghar Wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
06. Sar Ko Jhukaye Shahe Huda Lashe Pisar Par Dale Abaa
kehte Chale Innalilla Haye Asghar Wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
07. Khod Ke Beta Qabr Teri Zulm Ki Aandhi Aisi Chali
kaata Gaya Phir Zakhmi Gala Haye Asghar Wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
08. Soti Thi Jiske Seene Par Shashmahe Teri Qaahar
tujhko Mila Hai Wo Seena Haye Asghar Wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
09. Aage Aage Jhule Ke Haath Me Bache Kooze Liye
padhte Hai Sab Ye Nauha Haye Asghar Wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Zulmo Sitam Sab Haste Rahe Baano E Muztar Kehti Rahi
qabr Me Bhi Sone Na Diya Haye Asghar Wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
11. Kawishe Fikre Anwar Se Sunke Ye Nauha Hydar Se
kehte Hai Sab Ahle Aza Haye Asghar Wawaila
